description: This file defines a PHP class 'LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Dto'. The class extends 'DateRangeSearchFilterParams', uses a trait 'SubunitIdChainTrait', and provides various filtering parameters and constants specific to leave entitlement and usage reports within an HR management system. It includes properties for filtering by leave type, job title, employee numbers, subunit, location, and inclusion options for current/past employees, with corresponding getters and setters.
